verdict.rationale: Preventing user data from being used for model training is a fair privacy question for an AI search and assistant product like Perplexity, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a training opt-out, a data-retention control or a privacy setting. The community items about robots.txt and crawler behavior concern Perplexity crawling third-party sites, not the use of users' own data, so they are off-topic.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
